---
title: "Pre/post treatment analysis"
params:
  bennett_fingolimod: Blood    # BennettMS tissue kept for each drug (legend: Fingolimod blood,
  bennett_natalizumab: CSF     # Natalizumab CSF). Render the other view with e.g.
                               # rmarkdown::render(..., params = list(bennett_fingolimod = "CSF", bennett_natalizumab = "Blood"))
  sequences: contig            # contig: full TRUST4 contigs (published Fig. 3B); vj: V-J clipped like the
                               # classifier training data (dataset/09_treatment_vj.R); figures get a _vj suffix
---

```{r setup}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(rstatix)

FIGURES_DIR <- out_path("figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

BASELINE_TX <- c("Pretreatment", "Treatment naive", "No treatment",
                 "No recent treatment")

BASE <- out_path("sequence-classifier")

stopifnot(params$sequences %in% c("contig", "vj"))
SEQ_SUFFIX <- if (params$sequences == "contig") "" else paste0("_", params$sequences)

PRED_FILES <- list(
  "LM Exclusion AUGC" = file.path(BASE, paste0("treatment_predictions", SEQ_SUFFIX, "_exclusion.csv")),
  "LM Baseline AUGC"  = file.path(BASE, paste0("treatment_predictions", SEQ_SUFFIX, "_baseline.csv"))
)

# Known drug names to extract from the Treatment column via regex
KNOWN_DRUGS <- c("Natalizumab", "Fingolimod", "Ocrelizumab", "DMF") #skipping cladribine since very few sequences

# BennettMS tissue filtering (set in the params header; defaults follow the legend)
BENNETT_TISSUE <- c(Fingolimod = params$bennett_fingolimod, Natalizumab = params$bennett_natalizumab)
# Suffix for figure files, so each tissue view is saved under its own name
BENNETT_SUFFIX <- paste0("bennett_", paste0(names(BENNETT_TISSUE), BENNETT_TISSUE, collapse = "_"), SEQ_SUFFIX)

# Percentile used for per-patient score aggregation (change to e.g. 95 to use 95th pct)
SCORE_PCT <- 90
```

```{r load-treatment-predictions}
raw_preds <-
  imap(PRED_FILES, ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(model = .y)) %>%
  reduce(bind_rows)

cat(sprintf(
  "Loaded %s sequences across %d models\n",
  scales::comma(nrow(raw_preds)),
  n_distinct(raw_preds$model)
))

raw_preds %>%
  count(model, timepoint, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r patient-aggregation}
# Weighted percentile via sorted cumulative weights (mirrors Python summarize_patients.py)
weighted_percentile <- function(scores, weights, p) {
  if (length(scores) == 1L) return(scores)
  idx           <- order(scores)
  sorted_scores <- scores[idx]
  cum_w         <- cumsum(as.numeric(weights[idx]))
  cum_w         <- cum_w / cum_w[length(cum_w)]
  approx(cum_w, sorted_scores, xout = p / 100, rule = 2)$y
}

# Aggregate to patient × run × tissue × model.
# ms_score_pct = consensus-count-weighted Nth percentile of per-sequence MS scores.
patient_tx <- raw_preds %>%
  group_by(model, Author, Subject, Run, Treatment, timepoint,
           BSource, Disease, `Disease Class`, `Patient State`, EDSS) %>%
  summarize(
    ms_score_pct = weighted_percentile(ms_score, consensus_count, SCORE_PCT),
    n_seqs       = n(),
    .groups      = "drop"
  )

patient_tx %>%
  count(model, timepoint, Disease, BSource)
```

```{r parse-treatments}
# Extract drug name and timepoint from the Treatment column
drug_regex <- paste(KNOWN_DRUGS, collapse = "|")

# Post-treatment rows: extract drug and month-timepoint
post_rows <- patient_tx %>%
  filter(timepoint == "post") %>%
  mutate(
    drug      = str_extract(Treatment, drug_regex),
    tx_months = as.numeric(str_extract(Treatment, "\\d+(?=\\s*months?)"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(drug))   # drugs outside KNOWN_DRUGS (Cladribine) would otherwise form an "NA" facet

# Baseline rows: one copy per drug that the patient's post rows use
# (handles BennettMS where the same baseline pairs with two different drugs)
baseline_rows <- patient_tx %>%
  filter(timepoint == "baseline") %>%
  inner_join(
    post_rows %>% distinct(model, Author, Subject, BSource, drug),
    by = c("model", "Author", "Subject", "BSource"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  )

# Combine and build drug_label
patient_tx_parsed <- bind_rows(post_rows, baseline_rows) %>%
  mutate(drug_label = case_when(
    !is.na(tx_months) ~ paste0(drug, " ", tx_months, "mo (", Author, ")"),
    TRUE              ~ paste0(drug, " (", Author, ")")
  ))

# BennettMS tissue filter: keep one tissue per drug (BENNETT_TISSUE)
patient_tx_parsed <- patient_tx_parsed %>%
  filter(
    !(Author == "BennettMS" & drug %in% names(BENNETT_TISSUE) &
      BSource != BENNETT_TISSUE[drug])
  )

cat(sprintf("After parsing: %d rows, %d drug_labels\n",
            nrow(patient_tx_parsed), n_distinct(patient_tx_parsed$drug_label)))
patient_tx_parsed %>%
  count(model, Author, drug_label, BSource, timepoint) %>%
  print(n = 50)
```

```{r paired-data-construction}
# Explicit baseline/post join keyed on drug — preserves multi-timepoint
# resolution (e.g. a drug sampled at 6 and 12 months, each compared to baseline).
baseline_agg <- patient_tx_parsed %>%
  filter(timepoint == "baseline") %>%
  group_by(model, Author, Subject, BSource, Disease, `Disease Class`, drug) %>%
  summarize(baseline_pct = mean(ms_score_pct), .groups = "drop", count = sum(n_seqs))

post_agg <- patient_tx_parsed %>%
  filter(timepoint == "post") %>%
  group_by(model, Author, Subject, BSource, Disease, `Disease Class`,
           drug, drug_label, tx_months) %>%
  summarize(post_pct = mean(ms_score_pct), .groups = "drop", count = sum(n_seqs))

paired <- inner_join(baseline_agg, post_agg,
  by = c("model", "Author", "Subject", "BSource", "Disease", "Disease Class", "drug")
) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_pct = post_pct - baseline_pct,
    fc_pct    = post_pct / (baseline_pct + 1e-6)
  )

cat(sprintf(
  "Paired subjects: %d across %d studies (%d drug-timepoints)\n",
  n_distinct(paste(paired$Author, paired$Subject)),
  n_distinct(paired$Author),
  n_distinct(paired$drug_label)
))

paired %>%
  count(model, drug_label, BSource, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r paired-tests}
run_paired_tests <- function(df, metric_pre, metric_post, label) {
  # Per-drug-label tests (min 5 pairs)
  per_study <- df %>%
    group_by(model, drug_label, BSource) %>%
    filter(n() >= 2) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      wt <- wilcox.test(
        .x[[metric_post]], .x[[metric_pre]],
        paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE
      )
      tibble(
        statistic = wt$statistic,
        p.value   = wt$p.value,
        n_pairs   = nrow(.x),
        metric    = label
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Aggregated across all studies
  agg <- df %>%
    group_by(model, BSource) %>%
    filter(n() >= 2) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      wt <- wilcox.test(
        .x[[metric_post]], .x[[metric_pre]],
        paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE
      )
      tibble(
        drug_label = "All studies",
        statistic  = wt$statistic,
        p.value    = wt$p.value,
        n_pairs    = nrow(.x),
        metric     = label
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  per_study <- per_study %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))
  bind_rows(per_study, agg)
}

test_results <- run_paired_tests(
  paired %>% filter(model == "LM Exclusion AUGC"),
  "baseline_pct", "post_pct", sprintf("ms_score_%dpct", SCORE_PCT)
)

test_results %>%
  arrange(p_adj) %>%
  print(n = 50)
```

```{r trajectory-plot}
# Spaghetti plot: one line per patient connecting all available timepoints.
# Aggregates across runs to patient level, uses month-based x-axis so that
# multi-timepoint drugs (e.g. 6 and 12 months) appear in a single facet
# with Pre → 6mo → 12mo trajectory lines.
traj_data <- patient_tx_parsed %>%
  filter(model == "LM Exclusion AUGC") %>%
  mutate(
    study_drug = paste0(drug, " (", Author, ")"),
    tx_label = case_when(
      timepoint == "baseline" ~ "Pre",
      !is.na(tx_months)       ~ paste0(tx_months, "mo"),
      TRUE                    ~ "Post"
    ),
    month_num = case_when(
      timepoint == "baseline" ~ 0,
      !is.na(tx_months)       ~ tx_months,
      TRUE                    ~ 99
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Author, Subject, BSource, Disease, study_drug, tx_label, month_num) %>%
  summarize(ms_score_pct = mean(ms_score_pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(tx_label = fct_reorder(tx_label, month_num))

traj_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = tx_label, y = ms_score_pct,
             group = paste(Author, Subject), colour = Disease)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~study_drug, scales = "free") +
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = sprintf("MS score (%dth pct, weighted)", SCORE_PCT),
    title = "Pre/post treatment trajectories"
  ) -> p_trajectory
p_trajectory
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("fig3B_treatment_trajectories_", BENNETT_SUFFIX, ".svg")), p_trajectory, width = 6, height = 4)
```
